item.title: CBSE Holds Live Q&A Webinar on Registration and LOC for Board Examinations 2027 Webinar highlights CBSE’s focus on making examination-related processes more student-friendly and transparent
item.description: PRESS RELEASE New Delhi, 29.9.2026 CBSE Holds Live Q&A Webinar on Registration and LOC for Board Examinations 2027 Webinar highlights CBSE’s focus on making examination-related processes more student-friendly and transparent The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) organised a live webinar on “Relevance of Registration & LOC” today at the Auditorium, CBSE Integrated Office, Dwarka, New Delhi.
